name: Atelier
description: Eight analogue faces drawn from vintage dials, each with a working complication: steps, active minutes, floors, resting heart rate, battery or altitude. A different face each day, or pick one. Built and tested in the simulator on a Mac.

configFields.label: Face
configFields.description: 0 changes the face every day. 1 to 8 keeps one face: Field, Diver, Doctor, Track, Panda, Tricompax, Driver, Pilot.
